response.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / NULLIF(derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Line items with a zero or NULL derived_product_cost have no defined ratio, so they are excluded from the average but included in the line-item count.
